_notes: Decoder constants are one-based file offsets; SAM map offsets are adjusted to CPU-addressed NVRAM offsets.
Live game state verified against labeled wof_500 captures: 4 players, scores 713040/553320/1703250/1613120. Credits were observed as 8 but no reliable credit address was added.

SAM stores the 4 player scores as 4 x 8-byte (64-bit little-endian) fields: stride 8, not 4. The prior stride-4/length-4 layout mis-read players 2-4 (P2 read the zero high-bytes of P1, etc.). Corrected and validated against real 2-/3-/4-player Metallica dumps (mtl_180h).

_notes: Stern SAM number-of-players-in-game at fixed NVRAM address 0x02110900 (adjacent to game_over 0x02110904 in the SAM game-state header). Identified from three real played dumps: the only byte that reads exactly 2 / 3 / 4 in 2-, 3- and 4-player games (mtl_180h).

_notes: Stern SAM platform-wide credits counter at fixed NVRAM address 0x0211100C (redundant copy at 0x02111014). Identified by the stimulus-response harness (identify_game_state.py): the byte rises as coins are inserted and drops by exactly 1 when a game starts - a pricing-agnostic signature. Confirmed on mtl_180h, trn_174, avs_170, xmn_150.
